modules-for-hand-built-transactions-refu.text: Modules for hand-built transactions refused by the deployed validators.
Issue 764, first slice. Responsibilities and the direction of dependency. Fields are in the data model and signatures in the functions model.

dependency-direction.text: The driver depends on the harness and on the packaged command; the harness depends on the library; nothing in the library or the packaged commands depends on the harness or the driver. The packaged commands decline wrong requests before sending, so the means of building a wrong request stay in the test-only harness and never move into a product command or a library module.

placement.text: No abstraction is promoted. The shape of a case (build, submit, judge, restore, judge) already lives in the termination refusals driver and the registration refusals driver; this ticket uses the shared rig for everything the rig holds (the check-and-control helpers, the chain view, the wallets) and keeps the three judging functions in its own driver. The two existing drivers are not edited.
